title: Wildwood Druid
summary: Wildwood Druid is a humanoid Gaia-Titan who has the appearance of a walking tree with roots for legs, similar to Gybolg. A number of branches grow from her back, and she wears red and gold Celtic vestments. Wildwood Druid is the principal Titan belonging to Lane.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Wildwood Druid was used by Lane in the [[Casterwill Library]] during [[Lucas Casterwill|Lucas Casterwill's]] attack on the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team, who were trying do research on the [[Willblade]]. Wildwood Druid used her roots to immobilize [[Sorcerel]] and defeated her using her energy spores. She also attacked [[Sophie Casterwill]] but was met with an energy blast from [[Cherit]], setting her on fire. She then used her roots to entangle [[Zhalia Moon]] but these were disrupted by her [[Venomhand]] power. {{source|Chasing Void}}

Wildwood Druid was later invoked by Lane to fight against [[the Organization]] [[Suits]] whilst rescuing Sophie, Cherit and [[Lok Lambert]]. She used her toxic spores to defeat [[Gigadrone]]. {{source|Chasing Void}}

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* Wildwood Druid's summoning command is "'''I summon the power of nature'''."
* Wildwood Druid is based on the [[wikipedia:Druid|druids]], Celtic priests of Ancient Gaul. They are commonly associated with nature.
*In the [[Gaia-Titans]] fact files section of Issue 17 of the ''[[Huntik Magazine]]'', Wildwood Druid's file mistakenly confuses her with [[Gybolg]], calling her a furious warrior and saying that her Seeker is [[Scarlet Byrne]].

full_text:
Wildwood Druid is a humanoid Gaia-Titan who has the appearance of a walking tree with roots for legs, similar to Gybolg. A number of branches grow from her back, and she wears red and gold Celtic vestments. Wildwood Druid is the principal Titan belonging to Lane.

==History==
Wildwood Druid was used by Lane in the Casterwill Library during Lucas Casterwill's attack on the Huntik team, who were trying do research on the Willblade. Wildwood Druid used her roots to immobilize Sorcerel and defeated her using her energy spores. She also attacked Sophie Casterwill but was met with an energy blast from Cherit, setting her on fire. She then used her roots to entangle Zhalia Moon but these were disrupted by her Venomhand power. [Chasing Void]

Wildwood Druid was later invoked by Lane to fight against the Organization Suits whilst rescuing Sophie, Cherit and Lok Lambert. She used her toxic spores to defeat Gigadrone. [Chasing Void]

==Abilities==

Wildwood Druid is able to control leaves and roots, using her roots to immobilize her enemies. She can control these roots to grow from spots in the ground and capture her target much like the ability of Dark Dryad. She is also capable of releasing with toxic spores that can prove lethal to Titans like Sorcerel and Gigadrone. For Seekers, the only way to counter these spores is by holding one's breath. [Chasing Void]
